name: Tenma Tsukasa
source:
Tsukasa is the show off type of guy who's always overflowing with self-confidence, and has the tendency to get easily caught up in the moment. Ever since he watched a show performed by his favorite theater troupe as a kid, he has aimed to become the world's biggest star. He also has a reliable big brother side that shows when he's taking care of his little sister, [url=/c123760]Saki[/url], who was born with a weak body.

He's part of the musical show unit Wonderlands×Showtime.

[From in-game profile]
